# Travis Kupp

### Navigating Complexity

At UCB, a global biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Brussels, I lead the Strategic Foresight and Futures practice that translates emergent changes in market dynamics, healthcare ecosystems, and society into insight about future directions of human health. My previous work has spanned strategic design and innovation, corporate strategy, and enterprise project governance in multiple sectors, including banking, mobility, and energy.

I hold a Master of Science in Complex Systems Science from Arizona State University, a Master in Business Administration from California College of the Arts with a specialization in Strategic Foresight, and a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from University of California, Davis, with a minor in Technology Management.
